What is the Oracle Database? A database administrator (DBA) is a computer system administrator who manages a running database environment and conducts or performs all related activities to ensure data security. The primary responsibility of a DBA expert is to maintain data integrity. That means that the DBA ensures that the data protected from unauthorized access but that it is available to users. A database administrator typically has knowledge and experience of using a variety of database management products, e.g., B. based on Oracle, SAP and SQL software, as well as a degree in computer science and practical experience in the sector. Oracle DBA supports multiple complex and interdependent resource databases with systems of choice for large enterprise-level applications and the knowledge and skills to install, configure, and manage a database. Oracle DBA online training will certainly be required in the coming years to acquire additional skills. Companies and corporations rely on Oracle database administrators to manage their data safely and efficiently. Oracle database administrators manage capacity planning, evaluate database server hardware, and manage all aspects of an Oracle database, including installation, configuration, design, and data migration. Additional tasks include performance monitoring, security, backup, troubleshooting, and data recovery. What are Oracle database administrators doing? Install, correct, maintain and monitor Oracle databases Create and manage SQL and PL / SQL queries and shell scripts Monitor and review backups and perform ad hoc backups Provide maintenance support for database systems. Extraction, transformation, and loading of data Perform routine security and authentication measures Adaptation and resolution of database problems Many online job vacancies highlight the following skills, responsibilities, and applications when you apply for a database administrator (DBA) position: Installation, updating, and correction of the database Install and configure the relevant network components Ensure the access, the consistency and the integrity of the database Provide reports on various metrics, including availability, usage, and performance Work with the development team on architectures, coding standards, and quality assurance guidelines Build models for developing new databases or changing existing databases Respond to and fix database access and performance problems Monitor the details of the database system Design and implement redundant systems, policies, and procedures for disaster recovery Job Oriented Courses STEP in Cloud Computing STEP in DevOps Mastering Data Science STEP in Python Full Stack STEP in JAVA Full Stack STEP in Software Testing STEP in MEAN Stack Angular STEP in MERN Stack ReactJS STEP in Salesforce STEP in PHP Python Programming Python Programming Web Development in Python Cloud Computing AWS – Amazon Web Services AWS Cloud Practitioner DevOps with AWS DevOps – Dockers And Kubernetes Salesforce Microsoft Azure Data Analytics Data Science Artificial Intelligence Hadoop 2.X BigData Analytics Apache Spark & Scala Hadoop Admin Business Intelligence Tableau – Data Visualization Informatica Development – datawarehosuing Qlikview QlikSense Software Testing Selenium with Java Selenium With Python Tosca Training API Testing JMeter Testing LoadRunner Testing ETL Testing QTP / UFT RPA -
